g: Your overall life direction and central lesson.
s: A Life Path 22 is a master number path, the path of the master builder. Your life is built around turning a large vision into something real that lasts, often through organizations, institutions, or projects that serve many people. You combine the idealism of the 11 with the discipline and practicality of the 4. The lessons concern scale: the size of what you are capable of can be intimidating, and there are periods of pressure and self-doubt. Many people on a 22 path live as a 4 until they are ready for the larger work. Business, architecture, politics, and large-scale organizing suit you.
